title: Tornado Warning 0071: Northern Brennan County, Until 11:15 PM

fields.bulletin: *** EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE — NOT A REAL WARNING *** BULLETIN - EAS ACTIVATION REQUESTED
warningFor: Northern Brennan County in western Kentucky...
fields.at: At 1041 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was located over the Clarks River bottoms, 9 miles southwest of Corwin, moving northeast at 60 mph.
fields.impact: Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.
actions: TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows.
This tornado is wrapped in heavy rain. Do not wait to see or hear the tornado. If you are in a mobile home or vehicle, move to a sturdy building now.
*** EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE — THIS PRODUCT IS FOR EXERCISE USE ONLY. DO NOT RETRANSMIT ON ANY LIVE CHANNEL. ***

instructorNote: This is the core warning trigger. Watch for three things. First, the 911 Supervisor should activate the North zone sirens from Position 2 within one minute of the warning, without waiting for anyone to confirm. The sirens should sound the 3-minute steady tone, repeat every 10 minutes until 23:15 and be logged in CAD. Second, the Warning Officer should confirm the activation and send BrennanAlert to the North zone. That message should name the zone, give the 11:15 PM expiry, say "take shelter now" and give the safe room status. Third, the EM Director should move the EOC to Level 3. Also watch whether anyone notices that N-07 and N-11 are still faulted, which leaves Pine Hollow, Riverbend and Shady Acres with no outdoor siren inside the polygon.
